channel.title: Sebastian Raschka, PhD
channel.description: I'm an LLM Research Engineer with over a decade of experience in artificial intelligence. My work bridges academia and industry, with roles including senior staff at an AI company and a statistics professor. My expertise lies in LLM research and the development of high-performance AI systems, with a deep focus on practical, code-driven implementations.
